name.text: Plant vs Animal Fibers in Construction

questiontext.text:
Assignment: Plant vs Animal Fibers in Construction

Instructions

  1. Create a table comparing plant fibers and animal fibers used in construction. Include examples, properties, extraction/processing methods, and construction applications.
  2. Create a concise flowchart showing:

Fiber Type → Extraction → Treatment → Construction Application

Your work should be original, well organized, and clearly labelled.

graderinfo.text:
Grading Rubric

  • Classification (4): All plant and animal fibers correctly identified with examples.
  • Properties & Uses (4): Fiber properties clearly linked to construction uses.
  • Processing / Extraction (4): Correct sequence of extraction and treatment steps.
  • Applications (4): Each fiber linked to an appropriate construction application.
  • Clarity (4): Table and flowchart are neat, organized, and easy to follow.

generalfeedback.text:
Expected Components

  • A comparison table of plant and animal fibers.
  • Examples of plant fibers such as Jute, Sisal, Hemp, Flax, and Coir.
  • Examples of animal fibers such as Wool, Silk, and Horsehair.
  • For each fiber include:
    • Source
    • Properties
    • Extraction or processing
    • Construction application
  • A flowchart showing:

Fiber Type → Extraction → Treatment → Construction Application
